title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Panitian, Municipality of Quezon, Province of Palawan, to Be Known as the Quezon-Panitian National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Panitian, Municipality of Quezon, Province of Palawan, to Be Known as the Quezon-Panitian National High School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Panitian, Thị trấn Quezon, Tỉnh Palawan được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Quezon-Panitian
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Panitian, เทศบาล Quezon, จังหวัด Palawan ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Quezon-Panitian
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Panitian, Kotamadya Quezon, Provinsi Palawan dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Quezon-Panitian
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Panitian, Perbandaran Quezon, Wilayah Palawan dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Quezon-Panitian

text.en: There is hereby established a national high school in Barangay Panitian, Municipality of Quezon, Province of Palawan, to be known as the Quezon-Panitian National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue the necessary rules, circulars and regulations to implement this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 22, 2000.
